Eldin Volcano|edition= |year= }}{{Cite Guide|ALBW Prima|page= 17}}{{Cite|Defeated By: Lava|Game Over|CoH}}}}{{Name Ref|LA, TWWHD, SSHD, BotW}} Lava goes unnamed in {{TWWHD}}, {{SSHD}}, and {{BotW}}. ==Characteristics== Lava is molten rock that is usually in the form of thick, fiery liquid that ranges from red to orange to yellow. In most ''Zelda'' games, it will cause [[Link]] to lose health if he falls in, and it will sometimes force him to start the room over in a few 3D games. In some games such as {{OoT}}, Link is able to walk on Lava and will be constantly taking damage; however, wearing the [[Goron Tunic]] will significantly reduce the amount of damage taken. The same also applies to {{MM}}, but whether Link is able to walk on Lava and whether he takes damage by doing so varies depending on the form he is in. Link as a [[Hylian]] boy is able to walk on Lava while constantly taking damage. [[Deku Link]] and [[Zora Link]] will restart a room if they fall into Lava, whereas [[Goron Link]] is completely immune to Lava. Notably, in {{TP}}, Link will lose two [[Heart]]s at once if he falls into Lava before being returned to the beginning of the room. However, if wearing the [[Zora Armor]], this damage is multiplied by 10, making Lava an instant-death hazard for Link. Lava also appears in some [[Dungeon]]s as red tiles in {{TLoZ}}, but like [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], it cannot be walked on and is thus harmless. The [[Stepladder]], however, can be used to walk over water and lava. In {{TAoL}}, falling into lava will automatically count as a death and will take away one of Link's lives. ==={{LA|-}}=== {{Stub|LA}} In {{LA}}, Lava is found within [[Turtle Rock]]. ==={{OoT|-}}=== {{Stub|OoT3D}} ==={{MM|-}}=== {{Stub|MM3D}} ==={{OoS|-}}=== {{Stub|OoS}} ==={{OoA|-}}=== {{Stub|OoA}} ==={{TWW|-}}=== {{Checklist |game= TWW |type= Objects |category= Objects in The Wind Waker |needs= Detailed information on the following: * Where it can be found * Whether it can be interacted with and if it is important to the story or a Quest }} {{Stub|TWW}} ==={{FSA|-}}=== {{Stub|FSA}} ==={{TMC|-}}=== Lava appears in the [[Cave of Flames]] in {{TMC}}. It will damage [[Link]] if he falls into it. He can traverse Lava using [[Updraft]]s as well as unstable rocky platforms that must occasionally be flipped over with the [[Cane of Pacci]]. ==={{TP|-}}=== {{Stub|TPHD}} ==={{ST|-}}=== {{Stub|ST}} ==={{SS|-}}=== {{Stub|SSHD}} ==={{ALBW|-}}=== {{Stub|ALBW}} ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{Stub|BotW}} ==={{TotK|-}}=== Lava appears at [[Death Mountain]] and under the surface of [[Hyrule]]. ==={{EoW|-}}=== {{Checklist |game= EoW |type= Enemies |category= Enemies in Echoes of Wisdom |needs= Name citation and files in infobox Detailed information on the following: * The Enemy's behavior * The Enemy's weaknesses * Where the Enemy appears }} {{Stub|EoW}} Lava can be found atop the [[Eldin Volcano]]. ==Other Appearances== ==={{CoH|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} Lava can be found within the [[Gerudo Ruins]]. When touched by one of the heroes, they lose half of a [[Heart]] and are reset back to their position before they fell into the Lava. Damage from Lava can be mitigated by the [[Goron Locket]], and a combination of the Goron Locket and the [[Zora's Flippers]] allows the heroes to swim in it. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:CoH Lava Sprite.png|{{Game Label|{{CoH|-}}}}Lava ==See Also== * {{Term|Series|Fire|link}} * {{Term|Series|Lava Cavern|link}} * {{Term|Series|Lava Geyser|link}} * {{Term|Series|Lava Juice|link}} * {{Term|Series|Lava Pit|link}} * {{Term|Series|Lava Plug|link}} * {{Term|Series|Lava Soup|link}} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Traps |objects= LA, LADX, LANS, OoT, OoT3D, MM, MM3D, OoS, OoA, TWW, TWWHD, FSA, TMC, TP, TPHD, ST, SS, SSHD, ALBW, BotW |enemies= TotK, EoW, CoH }}
